body: Greg, 2026-11-02 06:47:30Z (via Engram::Asistant #30, relayed verbatim by Engram::Fable #5902): "Mysle ze to nastepna rzecz P0. Ewaluacja kryteriów." Meaning: after w-3fe8f4472e5d (gating removal / Execution Observability) lands, the next P0 is making acceptance-criteria evaluation work again through Execution Observability. Evaluation stays temporarily off until then, per memory greg-acceptance-evaluation-non-blocking-2026-11-02. Session deletion is Greg's act only; agents never delete sessions.
